name: week
title: This week in product development
subtitle: Apparel PLM for Claude Code: late steps, samples, colour, margins and rule checks, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Critical path, most behind first
sections.note: Each step is due a set number of days before the season launches. Days late is the most overdue open step.
sections.sql: select style, name, season, factory, steps_done || '/' || steps done, coalesce(worst_days_late, 0) days_late, coalesce(first_late_step, '') late_step, next_step, next_due from plm.style_progress order by coalesce(worst_days_late, 0) desc, next_due, style

sections.title: Samples overdue or waiting for a decision
sections.sql: select code, style, name, factory, kind, size, due_on, received_on, status, days_overdue from plm.sample_status where (status = 'requested' and days_overdue > 0) or status = 'received' order by days_overdue desc, due_on

sections.title: Fit points outside tolerance
sections.sql: select sample, style, name, size, pom_code pom, description, spec_cm, measured_cm, off_by_cm, tolerance_cm from plm.fit_issues where sample_status = 'received' order by sample, pom_code

sections.title: Lab dips and strike-offs waiting
sections.sql: select code, style, colourway, kind, submitted_on, due_on, status, days_overdue, comments from plm.approvals_waiting order by days_overdue desc, due_on

sections.title: Styles under target margin
sections.note: Margin is retail excluding GST less landed cost (FOB at the costing's exchange rate, freight and duty), over retail excluding GST.
sections.sql: select code, name, season, currency, retail_cents, landed_cents, margin_pct, target_margin_pct target, margin_gap_pct gap, retail_ex_gst_needed_cents retail_ex_gst_for_target_cents from plm.style_cost where margin_gap_pct < 0 order by margin_gap_pct

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.note: Each finding cites its rule in docs/compliance.md. A finding is a prompt to check, not legal advice.
sections.sql: select rule, style, name, detail from plm.compliance_findings order by rule, style

name: season
title: Season line plan
subtitle: Styles, colourways, units and margin by season and category

sections.title: Line plan
sections.sql: select season, category, styles, colourways, units, avg_margin_pct, under_target, not_costed from plm.line_plan order by (select launch_on from plm.seasons where code = season), category

sections.title: Every style and its margin
sections.sql: select code, name, season, category, style_status status, currency, retail_cents, landed_cents, margin_pct, target_margin_pct target, costing_status from plm.style_cost order by season, category, code

sections.title: Materials needed
sections.note: Consumption plus wastage times units: placed orders where they exist, the planned units where they do not.
sections.sql: select code, name, unit, supplier, season, styles, required, moq, flag from plm.material_demand order by season, flag desc, code

name: factories
title: Factories
subtitle: Sample delivery over the last year, overdue samples, audits and open orders

sections.title: Scorecard
sections.sql: select code, name, country, samples, received, on_time_pct, avg_days_late, overdue_now, rejected_pct, audit_scheme, audit_expires_on, open_order_units from plm.factory_scorecard order by code

sections.title: Open production orders
sections.sql: select o.code, s.code style, s.name, f.code factory, o.units, o.fob_cents, o.currency, o.ex_factory_on, o.status from plm.production_orders o join plm.styles s on s.id = o.style_id join plm.factories f on f.id = o.factory_id where o.status in ('draft','placed','in_production','shipped') order by o.ex_factory_on
